title: Single-cell RNAseq of Normoxic and OIR mouse retina by Drop-seq
P14_NORM_Rod_depleted_rep1
data_processing: Base calls performed with bcl2fastq2.15.
Read 2 was aligned with Star v2.4.0.
Each aligned read was tagged with its mate-pair UMI and cell barcode.
Each aligned exonic read was tagged with a gene name.
A digital expression matrix was built by counting the number of unique UMIs per gene within each cell; columns are cells, and rows are genes.
The first inflection point was estimated on a cumulative sum plot of the digital expression matrix to determine the number of cells in the sample.
Supplementary_files_format_and_content: NORM and OIR samples were merged and aligned together into a single matrix. log(1+10,000*(DGE normalized to total transcripts per cell)) calculated on DGE.
Genome_build: mm10 (GRCm38)

Supplementary_files_format_and_content: retina_NORM_OIR_P14_P17_C57_WR_CD73FT_noamg_normalizedUMI_Count_DGEmatrix.txt: Normalized UMI Count, Digital gene expression matrix. Compressed, flat text file with tab delimiters.
